note: Independent review copy for catalog planning and export estimates. The canonical body-family audit belongs to the 2D asset workstream (tools/2d-assets/, absent from this checkout) and is not changed here. A family assignment does not prove exact PNG compatibility.

baseline.description: Provisional male baseline from the handoff brief (49 species + Custom Lineage).

componentConcerns.description: Per-component fit concerns observed in the current male and female portraits (frontend/assets/species). They call for component variants (sleeves, footwear, back items, tail openings), not whole duplicate outfits.

baseArtEffects.Aasimar: halo already painted into the portrait
baseArtEffects.Kalashtar: psychic spirit aura already painted into the portrait
baseArtEffects.Changeling: second face/afterimage painted into the portrait

componentConcerns.baseClothingSilhouette: Most female portraits wear long skirts; most male portraits wear trousers and boots; Githzerai (male) wears a long robe. Lower-body armor must cover or mask the base skirt; this difference comes from base clothing, not anatomy.

proposedCorrections.evidence: Female portrait is slender with a narrow waist; male portrait is broad.

proposedCorrections.to: two art ids: githyanki, githzerai (both standard-tall)
proposedCorrections.evidence: Separate githyanki/githzerai portraits exist; the male Githzerai wears a floor-length robe.
Portraits show long-limbed, adult-proportioned plant figures, not small-bodied proportions.
Large head and ears, but torso and limb proportions look close to standard in the current art.
Feet off the ground with pointed toes and wings from the back; leg armor and back items need variants.

proposedCorrections.to: standard-tall plus a wing-arm component variant
proposedCorrections.evidence: The arms are feathered wings with clawed hands; sleeves, gauntlets and grips need a variant.
Bipedal goat legs with hooves; lower-leg armor and footwear could be shared with Minotaur.
No Bariaur portraits or catalog entries in this checkout.

fitPolicy.description: Assumptions used by the export estimate only.
